verses.text:
A Song of the Ascents.
Unto Thee I have lifted up mine eyes,
O dweller in the heavens.

Lo, as eyes of men-servants
Are unto the hand of their masters,
As eyes of a maid-servant
Are unto the hand of her mistress,
So are our eyes unto Jehovah our God,
Till that He doth favour us.

Favour us, O Jehovah, favour us,
For greatly have we been filled with contempt,

Greatly hath our soul been filled
With the scorning of the easy ones,
With the contempt of the arrogant!
